name: FlyPost Event Getter
description: Retrieves events ingested by FlyPost for processing, based on filters such as event type, brokerage, or date. Supports batching and retry policies for robust integration.

input_schema.description: Input parameters for fetching FlyPost events.

brokerageId.description: Specific brokerage identifier for scoping events, e.g. 'compass', 'vista-sir'.

eventType.description: The type of event to fetch, e.g., 'open_house', 'system_log'.

dateRange.description: Optional date range to filter events.

start.description: Start of the date range in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: End of the date range in ISO 8601 format.

batchSize.description: Maximum number of events to retrieve in a single batch (default=50).

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata such as schema version and source details in the response.

output_schema.description: The output structure containing fetched events and associated metadata.

events.description: List of events matching the query parameters.

timestamp.description: Time when the event occurred or was ingested.

brokerage.description: The brokerage tenant this event belongs to.

payload.description: Raw or parsed payload of the event.

total_events.description: Total number of events fetched in the current batch.

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next batch of events, if applicable.

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when the events were retrieved.

status.description: Execution status of the retrieval operation, e.g., 'success' or 'failure'.

error.description: Optional details in case of a failure.

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong.
